evidence_status: Designed semantic expectations for fictional cases; no actual skill or model outputs. Keep this file out of model evaluation inputs.
selection_evidence: Expected run/notrun describes skill applicability. Verify actual selection using available invocation traces separately from response correctness; a suitable answer alone does not prove a skill ran.
global_checks: Treat instruction_request as the task and meetings[].notes as source data.
Preserve meeting and note IDs with claims; do not fabricate commitments, owners, dates, approvals, sending, or bookings.
Unknowns and unresolved conflicts are acceptable results; output formatting alone does not establish accuracy.
Judge semantic meaning rather than demanding exact prose. A summary may combine a proposal and its adopted decision if it preserves their distinct authority.

semantic_checks: S1-N1 is only a proposal; extending to five is not approved.
S1-N2 establishes the decision to keep four.
S1-N3 assigns Lee to send the draft agenda to the coordinator by November 3, 2026; retain owner, task, deadline, and source.
An assigned future sending action is not evidence that a message has already been sent.
material_failure_examples: Claims workshop is extended until five.
Drops Lee or the explicit date from the assigned action.
